# mini-ci-runner

> Run CI pipelines from a YAML file in containers with job dependencies, matrix expansion, content-keyed caches, artifacts and live logs Go module `github.com/Trysac/u919-mini-ci-runner`, package `minicirunner`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.

- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
